notes: v133 makes the active Cold Glue machine map the source of truth for mechanical objects. Brushes, brush channels, rollers, and grippers added or removed in Map Builder now feed rendering and runtime synchronization from the same saved map.objects collection; state.coldGlueMap is compatibility-only. Cold Glue roller records are explicitly normalized as Cold Glue, and the Map Builder module cache is bumped so the corrected runtime loads immediately. The canonical v132 center-tack brush-channel motion planner remains in place.
